reassessment_reason: Reconfirmed custom Computer Query pricing and separated it from the lookup API. The API guide has a contradictory CommercialLookup path that requires publisher clarification before implementation.

candidate.publisher: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
candidate.product: custom Computer Query; separate Commercial API lookup service
candidate.price: Computer Query: $25 for first 40 records plus $0.01 per additional record; current live API quote not established

access.bulk: Official order instructions offer request-defined custom multi-entity queries; a complete recurring statewide extract contract remains unverified.
access.api: REST JSON uses token plus account email; live tokens are paid and test tokens return test data. Limits are 18 calls/minute and 1,000 search results; no pagination or change-feed contract is documented.
access.automation: The documented API supports customer back-end use, subject to subscription terms. This does not authorize portal harvesting or statewide enumeration.

fields.summary: The guide documents entity identifiers, charter status, address structures and natural-person sections. CommercialLookup names /api/Commercial/Search in the method section but /api/Commercial/Lookup in its appendix. Header version/date and revision-history entries also differ; no route was probed.

active_status_semantics: Charter and annual-report standing are legal filing assertions; operating-business status and status-code lifecycle remain unverified.
statewide_completeness: The 1,000-result API cap and undocumented enumeration contract cannot establish a statewide baseline. A custom query needs an explicit entity-class scope and complete as-of count.
address_zip: Address structures include ZipCode and AddressType; published value semantics are insufficient to identify physical sites. Future outputs must keep ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate and exclude agent/person contact fields.
automation_terms_fees: Official query pricing is documented. Account, token, current agreement and permitted scope remain prerequisites for live API use; no signup, payment or acceptance occurred.
redistribution: No reviewed grant of indefinite retention, derived publication or redistribution was established for a custom extract.
temporal_refresh: No recurring custom-extract cadence, full/delta/deletion, correction, replay or checksum contract established.

citations.evidence: Custom Computer Query availability and per-record pricing; registry display includes agent/person details.
Token requirement, request/result limits, published fields, inconsistent lookup route, and disclaimer-change response.

strongest_next_action: Prepare a document-only query for a complete person-free custom extract quote, schema, current rights and refresh contract. Include the guide's lookup-route discrepancy if API integration is contemplated; do not substitute capped name searches for statewide acquisition. Separate authorization is required before sending.
